svg.title: 01 | Project overview
svg.desc: Secure Task By Akuphe. Manually dispatched GitHub Actions, seven scanners, private DefectDojo, gated Terraform and staging-to-production deployment on AWS ECS Fargate.
svg.text: Seven security scanners. Evidence in DefectDojo. One scanned image promoted from staging to production.
GitHub Actions | Manually triggered with workflow_dispatch
Source, image and runtime findings imported through encrypted SSM tunnels
Missing reports, scan errors or blocking findings stop the release. Manual approval cannot turn a failed security gate green.
Must pass before any AWS creation
Separate approved workflow destroys project resources
Two availability zones | Logical service placement
PRIVATE SUBNETS - no public task IPs
EC2 + encrypted EBS | PostgreSQL, Valkey and Celery containers
Scanned images; Fargate pulls by digest
Private Dojo access and report transport
Tutorial defaults: one task per service, single-AZ RDS and one NAT gateway. No custom domain.
Build once. Scan before ECR. Inspect staging. Approve production. All entry workflows are manually dispatched.
